intro.text: The Sorting Yards are in chaos. Crates pile up in random order, and the night shift can't find anything.
Quack. Start small: the crane can only swap two neighbouring crates. What order would you fix them in?

mid.text: Nice work. Now the real trouble: a single crate is missing from a long sorted aisle.
Quack. Checking crates one by one is slow. A sorted row lets you throw half of them away with every look.

outro.text: You just used the idea behind binary search: sorted data pays you back in speed.
Quack. Next stop: Warehouse Row, where memory gets messy.

games.title: Fix the Conveyor
games.instructions: Click a crate, then a neighbour to swap. Sort ascending. Beat par for 3 stars.

games.title: Find Crate 37
games.instructions: Crates are sorted but hidden. Click to reveal one. You only get 4 probes; a left-to-right scan won't make it.
